input.summary: The repository was audited across all nine DevOps inspection areas. Multiple severe security violations were identified in the GitHub Actions workflows, including hardcoded database passwords, AWS secret keys, PyPI tokens, and Docker Hub tokens in workflow environment blocks. Additionally, workflows exposed secrets through logging (echo and printenv), passed secrets as command-line arguments, used bash tracing (set -x) with sensitive data, performed verbose HTTP requests logging authorization headers, and uploaded sensitive configuration files, environment files, private keys, and SSH credentials as workflow artifacts.
